What I’m working on

In progress

Flood and windstorm safety system

A school electronics project about floods and storms in Assam. The plan uses Arduino or ESP32 with rain, water-level and wind sensors, warning levels, solar power and a smart shelter model. Some features are still ideas and are being tested.

What pulls me in

Design

Logos, posters, typography, colour, photo and video editing. I like work that looks distinctive, not generic.

PC hardware, Python, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, AI tools, and electronics with Arduino and ESP32.

Chill · Peaceful · Dreamy

My personality

Curious, independent, hands-on
